timing_verdict.label: NEUTRAL
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: NEUTRAL timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,530.5 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is currently at 1,530.5 KRW per dollar—neither particularly weak nor strong historically. While one analyst expects the rate could break 1,600 won in Q3 (suggesting further weakening ahead), Hanhwa Securities forecasts gradual decline from here, indicating the external headwinds may have peaked. This conflicting outlook creates uncertainty about near-term direction.

TIP: Since you must convert $2,000 monthly regardless, consider setting a small monthly budget slightly ahead of schedule during unexpectedly strong-won days (sub-1,520 KRW/USD) to reduce average cost over time.
